3d.description: 3D web experience — Three.js, React Three Fiber, Spline, WebGL, interactive 3D scenes, product configurators

game.description: Phát triển game HTML5 — support 2D (Phaser), 3D (Three.js), Isometric. Load orchestrator + workflow.
game.template: Load `skills/game-development/SKILL.md` → route đến đúng sub-skill theo platform/dimension. Sau đó chạy `workflows/game.workflow.md`.

ui-ux.description: UI/UX design — web (React/Tailwind), game HUD, CLI output

preview.description: Start game live preview dev server (Vite HMR + browser auto-open)
preview.template: Load `skills/games-preview/SKILL.md`. Then run: `npm run dev` (hoặc `npx vite --open --host` nếu chưa có script).

compile.description: Prompt Compiler — phân tích intent, extract constraints, sinh IR, tối ưu prompt cho LLM backend. Zero AI, zero token.
compile.template: Load `skills/prompt-compiler/SKILL.md`. Input → Pipeline 14 stages → IR → Backend prompt. Dùng `ts-node prompt-compiler/src/index.ts` hoặc import Pipeline.

init.description: Khởi tạo project mới với scaffold wizard
init.template: Chạy: `node runtime/bin/vibe.mjs init` hoặc `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/scaffold.ps1`

status.description: Xem trạng thái session, memory, pipeline

onboard.description: Onboarding wizard cho người dùng mới
